mintAuthority.headline: Issuer signers can mint without an on-chain cap; the EVM administrator can replace mint logic immediately.
mintAuthority.summary: Native issuance remains under issuer authority. ZARU has a System Program Solana signer and the same EOA with mint/admin/upgrader powers on three EVM chains.

controls.label: Solana Token-2022 mint authority

sources.label: Exact archived mint and signer account state, Solana slot 457208926, 2026-10-15T10:45:27Z

controls.evidence: Exact finalized Alchemy Account Archive reads of the mint and signer both return context slot 457208926, blockhash 6GFVeAGF3msuiviWBgrT8fbJakKhkUfgyn63oRsxypYr, timestamp 2026-10-15T10:45:27Z. The Token-2022 mint retains sole mintAuthority and freezeAuthority 8USLqNrJ6WfUcTk2XUBYGRiMA2Mp2qh9AhsJZBEg5W62; its signer is a nonexecutable, zero-data System Program account, not an SPL multisig. Supply is 60553096194140 base units with 6 decimals. The same signer controls permanent delegate, pause, transfer hook, transfer fees, metadata and mint-close extensions. Pause is false, the hook program is unset and both transfer-fee schedules and interest rates are zero. The prior October 5 archival census remains historical: 854 transactions, 39 mints and 24 burns reconciled 60552996194140 base units then; it is not a fresh complete transaction census. No native numeric issuance cap, independently verified HSM custody or human independence is established.

Nine successful pinned Dwellir log windows extend the retained complete inventory from block 26110184 through 26197399 with no returned role, upgrade or pause changes; a historical positive-log window independently returns four grants to the same address. accessRegistry() is 0xfa51dd24f7348d5f0e6c5a5a00213d85ca401da9. EIP-1967 retains implementation 0x0f25045d15c163478bb67c56c5d9d602628f4f62; its 15673-byte runtime equals the Base and Arc implementations byte-for-byte at their review pins. Verified ERC20F source gates uncapped mint by MINTER_ROLE and immediate UUPS replacement by UPGRADER_ROLE. Current totalSupply is explicitly zero and paused() is false. No independently established human quorum or HSM custody is inferred.

review.evidence: Reviewed native issuance on October 5, 2026. Arc's terminal eight-grant/zero-revoke explorer history plus a successful 27-window indexing-tail census establishes the sole eight-role EOA through block 24360273. All current Arc memberships and default-admin relationships are pinned. Ethereum/Base earlier complete role inventories remain sourced; current implementation slots and codeless authority are corroborated at Ethereum 26124902, Base 52199351 and Arc 24360273. Each chain's deployed ERC20F executable equals Sourcify's recompiled source runtime: substitute the observed 32-byte __self address at byte offsets 3167, 3231, 3585, 3649 and 3792, then remove only the final 53-byte CBOR section. All 15620 executable bytes agree; no other normalization is used. Unbounded immediate mint/admin/upgrade economics are retained. Incident review searched issuer home, whitepaper, legal and blog disclosures, published audit claims, indexed issuer X, rekt.news and exploit searches. Direct X access was blocked and the whitepaper promises rather than supplies a contract audit. All 854 archival Solana mint-address transactions through finalized slot 453523097 were fetched without errors, reaching creation slot 373091718. The 39 mints all use the identified sole issuer signer; 24 burns yield the exact pinned supply 60552996194140 base units. Terminal Ethereum/Base/Arc Transfer histories show one 100-token mint and corresponding burn on each chain; each mint/burn caller is the identified role EOA and all three pinned current supplies are zero. No active or resolved native unauthorized-mint incident was identified in this review. This is not financial backing assurance or a custody-independence claim. Reconciliation-only refresh on 2026-10-07: the issuer's 2026-07-21 whitepaper sections 3.04 and 4.14 define monthly on-chain total-supply verification and liabilities-versus-reserves reconciliation. The subsequently published Moore Blockchain and Digital Assets JHB (Pty) Ltd report signed 2026-10-01 covers the common 2026-08-31 14:00 UTC snapshot: page 2 defines Total Issued ZARU Supply across approved blockchains and reports zero noncirculating supply; procedures 6 and 8 identify exact Solana mint 2WvREMqcoxtGuKTyyuzVMH7xDkeH8mY6phduvUofPRXN at slot 443168748, enumerate all token accounts and reconcile their aggregate 61576130.774140 ZARU to mint supply without difference. Procedures 3, 10-12 match that liability to independently obtained Standard Bank and Sanlam statements totalling ZAR 62675198.86, with reported reserve coverage 101.78%. Together with the already cited July snapshot report, this establishes a recurring periodic whole-supply reconciliation, not NAV/AUM equivalence or current reserve coverage. The report explicitly says ISRS 4400 AUP is not an assurance engagement and expresses no assurance conclusion; supervision therefore remains unknown, not attestation-only or prudential. Subsequent EVM deployments are not asserted to be individually attested by the August snapshot. Historical licensing corroboration added 2026-10-15: FSCA's official March 2026 licensed-CASP list, page 20 row 170, identifies FSP 55172, Loop South Africa (Pty) Ltd, Category I, intermediary services; Moore's October 1 report identifies BlockTower South Africa as formerly Loop. Current October licence status and product-specific prudential mint-supervision scope remain independently unverified; the dated intermediary-services entry does not establish either. The prior register-maintenance observation remains historical. All named key-custody questions remain open.
